736:t_1:407.en:
$$メール$$
「Looks like $$セツコ$$ is going to stay in the military even after this war is over.」

736:t_1:408.en:
$$ランド$$
「We'll keep on being repairmen, too.」

736:t_1:409.en:
$$ランド$$
「We can't take down the $$ビーター・サービス$$ sign, not when we need it to find the Boss.」

736:t_1:411.en:
$$エスター$$
(I'll never understand that one taste of hers...)

736:t_1:412.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「$$クロウ$$, what do you intend to do once the world is at peace?」

736:t_1:414.en:
$$エスター$$
「What's gotten into you, all of a sudden!?」

736:t_1:415.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I'd completely forgotten, but the grace period on repaying my debt only lasts until this war is over...」

736:t_1:417.en:
$$クロウ$$
「A debt of 1,000,000 G... The day peace comes, the collection begins...」

736:t_1:418.en:
$$エスター$$
「So what are you going to do!? There probably won't be any more $$次元獣$$s showing up, so the Buster work will dry up too, right!」

736:t_1:419.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Even so, nothing is worth trading for peace... Even if that 1,000,000 G collection starts, I'll fight those bastards with everything I've got.」

736:t_1:421.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I respect the way you live.」

736:t_1:422.en:
$$トライア$$
「Blushing over a remark like that, huh... Love is blind, and that's a scary thing.」

736:t_1:423.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Chief! If you came here, that means...」

736:t_1:424.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right. He managed to wake up somehow.」

736:t_1:429.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Truthfully, he should still be resting...」

736:t_1:431.en:
$n
「Besides, if this is going to be the last battle, I can't just lie in bed.」

736:t_1:432.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're not thinking something like, we need the $$いがみ合う双子$$ to seal the power of the $$御使い$$s, are you?」

736:t_1:433.en:
$n
「...You saw the last battle. If I can't even hold $$アサキム$$ down, I'm no use to anyone...」

736:t_1:434.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's all right. No one has to shoulder everything alone.」

736:t_1:435.en:
$$トライア$$
「For now, we've reinforced the dimensional barriers as much as we possibly could. With that, we seal the $$御使い$$s.」

736:t_1:436.en:
$$甲児$$
「We've done all the preparation we could. All that's left is to bet on it.」

736:t_1:437.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So... we fight with the strength of all of us.」

736:t_1:439.en:
$$カレン$$
「All right, now that our resolve is settled, let's hear from $n too.」

736:t_1:440.en:
$$シン$$
「What do you want to do once there's peace?」

736:t_1:443.en:
$$クラン$$
「You, who stubbornly refused no matter how much everyone around you urged you to!?」

736:t_1:444.en:
$$アルト$$
「What brought on the change of heart?」

736:t_1:445.en:
$$甲児$$
「Is it a makeover to go with you ditching the quiet type act?」

736:t_1:447.en:
$n
(I don't need to chase after Mom's likeness anymore...)

736:t_1:448.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Is there anything else? Something like a dream for the future.」

736:t_1:449.en:
$n
「I wrote $$ビーストハンター$$ on my school career survey, but...」

736:t_1:450.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What are you going to do in the hunter's off-season?」

736:t_1:451.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think you'd make a good test pilot now, $n. Your piloting technique has grown enough, too.」

736:t_1:452.en:
$$ランド$$
「No, no...! Your attention to detail and your stubbornness are made for repair work!」

736:t_1:453.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Your field combat skills work in the city too... How about being a stylish private eye with me? I'll pay a decent salary.」

736:t_1:455.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Trained in heart by $$ランド$$, in skill by $$セツコ$$, and in body by $$クロウ$$, you should be able to aim for the heights, $n.」

736:t_1:456.en:
$n
「Heart, skill, body... Maybe I'll try for yokozuna.」

736:t_1:457.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your growth, $n, is also reflected in the simulation results.」

736:t_1:458.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your overall record is 224 wins and 387 losses.」

736:t_1:460.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You were a complete novice at first, after all. But if you look only at your record since the $$時獄戦役$$, it's 156 wins and 145 losses.」

736:t_1:464.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You really might become a good test pilot.」

736:t_1:465.en:
$$ランド$$
「No, no...! He's a hot-blooded repairman!」

736:t_1:466.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Wrong. He's a hard-boiled private eye.」

736:t_1:467.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Honestly! This is no time to be saying things like that!」

736:t_1:468.en:
$n
「You're right... And here we are, right before the decisive battle with the $$御使い$$s...」

736:t_1:469.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's not what I mean, $n... Do you think you can graduate the way things are now!?」

736:t_1:471.en:
$$宗介$$
「She's right, $n. Our battle will go on even after we've restored peace.」

736:t_1:472.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's bad. We swore to everyone in Class 2-4 that we'd all graduate together, and yet...」

736:t_1:474.en:
$n
「Let's make sure we come back alive! Having won the future!」

736:t_1:478.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Truthfully, he should still be resting...」

736:t_1:480.en:
$n
「Besides, if this is going to be the last battle, I can't just lie in bed.」

736:t_1:481.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're not thinking something like, we need the $$いがみ合う双子$$ to seal the power of the $$御使い$$s, are you?」

736:t_1:482.en:
$n
「...You saw the last battle. If I can't even hold $$アサキム$$ down, I'm no use to anyone...」

736:t_1:483.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's all right. No one has to shoulder everything alone.」

736:t_1:484.en:
$$トライア$$
「For now, we've reinforced the dimensional barriers as much as we possibly could. With that, we seal the $$御使い$$s.」

736:t_1:485.en:
$$甲児$$
「We've done all the preparation we could. All that's left is to bet on it.」
